get.description:
The artist's About as the profile shows it: the saved bio for a claimed artist, otherwise the directory's prepared About when it is still current, otherwise the claim prompt. The ordinary read is public and read-only.

The compatibility query `regenerate=true` changes saved data and requires the claimant's or an admin's Bearer token. Prefer [PUT /api/artistBio/{id}](/api-reference/artist-bio/update-about) for an explicit regeneration request and its authenticated Try it panel. GET regeneration returns its existing `{ status, bio, pinned?, message? }` shape, not PUT's `{ status, message, bio? }` shape, and keeps the previous text in bio history.

### Saved-material regeneration
The approved claimant or a Music Nerd admin must authenticate with a Privy access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Trusted-contributor status alone does not grant regeneration.

Regeneration prepares missing or stale Lore from already saved eligible readable material, then generates About. A current Lore document is reused. It does not start source discovery/extraction, full research or onboarding. A newly submitted URL may still need processing or moderation before it is eligible. A pinned bio is returned unchanged; unpin it before requesting regeneration.

A successful Lore step alone is not About success. If preparation succeeds but About generation fails, the prepared Lore may remain saved while the previous About is preserved. Claim, source, Lore document and About changes are checked before saving so an outdated generation does not overwrite newer state.

### Errors and retries
Errors have `{ "status": "error", "error": "...", "code"?: "..." }`. The code is optional: clients must handle errors without one.

- `409 LORE_REQUIRED`: no usable approved, readable Lore could be prepared. Explain source processing/review prerequisites and retain the displayed About.
- `409 LORE_PREPARING`: another Lore/About generation owns the lease. Show a busy state and retry later rather than starting simultaneous generation.
- `409` without a required code: a source, claim, Lore document or About changed before save. Reload current state before retrying.
- `500 LORE_PREPARATION_FAILED`: preparation or settlement failed. Keep the displayed About and follow the returned recovery guidance; a lease cleanup failure asks the caller to wait a few minutes.
- `408`: a timeout mapped by the About generator. Preserve About and allow a deliberate later retry.
- `500` without a required code: About generation, lease cleanup or another operation failed. Do not claim success from an earlier Lore step.

The handler starts a 45-second generation budget at entry; the host route declares 60 seconds. This is not a hard wall-clock guarantee across authentication, database stalls and host termination. Preparation-stage aborts can surface as preparation failures rather than `408`. After a lost response or other uncertain outcome, check saved state with the ordinary read before retrying. An ordinary read never starts generation.

This is the regeneration contract for [MusicNerdWeb#1655](https://github.com/xdjs/MusicNerdWeb/issues/1655). Deployment availability is tracked separately; these docs do not establish production rollout.

post.summary: Report a problem with the About
post.description: Files a correction report on the artist's About for an admin to review; any signed-in user may send one. `expectedBio` is the About text the caller read, so a report never lands on an About that has since changed. The same report sent again is acknowledged as a duplicate, and an account may file at most 10 reports in a rolling 24 hours.

details.description: What should change, in the reporter's words. Optional; trimmed.

sourceUrl.description: A public web page that backs the report. Optional; a bare domain gets `https://`. Private or local addresses are refused.

expectedBio.description: The About text the reporter saw, exactly as the read endpoint returned it.

example.details: The band has had twelve members since 2024.
example.expectedBio: Bio Ritmo is a 10-piece salsa band from Richmond, Virginia.

200.description: An identical pending report from this account already exists; nothing new was filed.

400.description: `id` isn't a UUID, the body isn't JSON, or the report has no valid reason, details or source URL.

post.description: Adds a public web page to the artist's vault as a suggested Lore source, for any signed-in user. An admin's or whitelisted contributor's source is approved at once and a Lore refresh is queued; anyone else's waits for review, with `sourceStatus` `pending`. A URL already in the vault, with or without its fragment, is refused.

url.description: A public http(s) page. A bare domain gets `https://`; the fragment is dropped. IP addresses and private or local hosts are refused.

201.description: The source was saved. `sourceStatus` is `approved` for a trusted contributor (a Lore refresh is queued) or `pending` for review. `warning` is present when the source was approved but the Lore refresh could not be queued.

approvedNoRefresh.summary: Approved, but the Lore refresh could not start

value.warning: Source saved and approved, but the Lore refresh could not start. An artist or admin can retry it. You do not need to submit again.

get.description: Whether the research started when an artist was added to the directory is still running, and a fingerprint of the profile's public links that changes when they do. Only the account that added the artist, or an admin, may read it, and only within 24 hours of the artist being added.

200.description: The discovery state and the current link fingerprint. Carries `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

401.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no Music Nerd user for it.

404.description: Nothing to observe: no such artist, no directory research for it, it was added more than 24 hours ago, or the caller is neither the adding account nor an admin.

503.description: The status could not be read.

get.description: Downloads the artist's Lore document as one self-contained Markdown file: a dated header, the document with its `[n]` citation markers, and the numbered sources it cites. `format=csv` returns the sources as a CSV table instead. Only the artist's approved claimant or an admin may export it.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the source table. Anything else, or nothing, for the Markdown document.

200.description: The file, as an attachment named `<artist-slug>-<date>.md` or `<artist-slug>-sources-<date>.csv`.

Access-Control-Expose-Headers.description: `Content-Disposition`, so a cross-origin download can read the file name.

text/markdown.example:
# Bio Ritmo

> Verified profile compiled by Music Nerd from 2 sources, exported 2026-10-21.
> Bracketed numbers in the text refer to the numbered sources at the end.

Bio Ritmo is a salsa band from Richmond, Virginia, formed in 1991 [1].

## Sources

1. About · bioritmo.com — https://www.bioritmo.com/about
2. Interview answer: how the band started

401.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no Music Nerd user for it.

403.description: The user is neither the artist's claimant nor an admin.

404.description: No such artist, or no Lore document yet.

privyBearer.description: The signed-in user's access token. Copy it at https://musicnerd.net/access after signing in. Each operation says who may call it: any signed-in user, or the artist's approved claimant or a Music Nerd admin.

code.description: Optional regeneration detail. LORE_REQUIRED means no usable approved, readable Lore; LORE_PREPARING means a competing lease; LORE_PREPARATION_FAILED means preparation or settlement failed. Not every error has a code.

PublicArtistAbout.description: The directory's prepared About for an unclaimed artist, with the sources it cites. Only returned while the artist's links and sources still match what it was written from.

kind.description: `official` when it rests on the artist's own page or account; `researched` otherwise.

bio.description: The saved bio for a claimed artist; otherwise the directory About's text, or the claim prompt when there is nothing verified to show.

publicAbout.description: The directory About for an unclaimed artist, or `null`.

pinned.description: `true` when a pinned version blocked the regeneration; `bio` is the unchanged About.

bio.description: After a regeneration: the About now saved.

duplicate.description: `true` when an identical pending report from this account already existed.

sourceStatus.description: `approved` for an admin's or whitelisted contributor's source; `pending` for review.

warning.description: Present when the source was approved but the Lore refresh could not be queued.

state.description: `active` while directory research jobs are pending or running; `complete` when all finished; `failed` when one gave up; `stopped` once the artist is claimed.

revision.description: A fingerprint of the profile's public link destinations; a change means the links changed.
